info.name: CourseGap Companion API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection testing the Student Academic Progress API (JSON Server) for CourseGap Companion. Covers GET (all and by ID), POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, and HEAD requests with assertions and request bodies.

request.description: Retrieves the complete roster of students with their semester progress, attendance, and subject marks.
Retrieves detailed academic profile and subject breakdown for a specific student ID (e.g. ID: 1).

body.raw:
{
  "id": "7",
  "name": "Meera Nair",
  "email": "meera.nair@example.edu",
  "semester": 3,
  "attendance": 71,
  "overallMarks": 58,
  "status": "At Risk",
  "subjects": [
    {
      "code": "CS301",
      "name": "Object-Oriented Programming",
      "marks": 45,
      "attendance": 69,
      "gap": true
    },
    {
      "code": "CS302",
      "name": "Digital Logic & Design",
      "marks": 70,
      "attendance": 74,
      "gap": false
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Completely replaces an existing student record with updated grades and remedial status cleared.
Partially updates student fields (e.g. updating attendance and status) without modifying unaffected fields.
Deletes a student record by ID (e.g. ID: 7 created during testing).
Sends a HEAD request to check HTTP headers, server status, content length, and cache directives without retrieving response body.
